answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 8790 Country: India Title: Is it permissible for a Muslim whose financial condition does not allow a goat to be sacrificed on eid uz zuha to slaughter poultry on that day in lieu of goat? Question: Is it permissible for a Muslim whose financial condition does not allow a goat to be sacrificed on eid uz zuha to slaughter poultry on that day in lieu of goat? Answer ID: 8790 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1084/1084=M/1429) One is not asked to do Qurbani of chicken if he is not able to do wajib Qurbani. If the Qurbani of other animals like chicken, bird etc would have been valid, it must have been done in the poverty-stricken days of the Prophet and his companions. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
